quests.title: Get to the only pile
quests.ask: There is just one pile ahead. Go to it and collect all of it.
quests.nudge: The first number in the list is for the cell in front of you. Which cell is that?

quests.title: Pick out the biggest pile
quests.ask: There are several piles. Collect only the biggest one and leave the others where they are.
quests.nudge: The first pile you meet isn't always the biggest. How could you find where the biggest number sits?

quests.title: Richest pile against the wall
quests.ask: This time the biggest pile is on the last cell before the wall. Collect it and leave the small one.
quests.nudge: Picture the robot's last step. Does it land on the pile or bump the wall?
